entities.summary: Alejandro Castro Espín is a Cuban political and military figure. He holds the rank of Brigadier General in the Interior Ministry of Cuba. He is the only son of Raúl Castro, the former First Secretary of the Communist Party of Cuba, and Vilma Espín, one of the main leaders of the Cuban Revolution; he is a nephew of Fidel Castro. Alejandro Castro Espín was a military leaders & commanders from Havana (b. 1965-07-29, Havana). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to geopolitics.
